nodes.label: JSON Response Structure
nodes.rationale: Structured JSON with composite code, human-readable message, data payload on success, and optional errors for validation failures.

nodes.label: 7-Digit Response Code Model
nodes.rationale: HTTP_STATUS_CODE + SERVICE_CODE + CASE_CODE enables consistent error handling, observability, and service-level troubleshooting. Keep codes immutable once published; add new cases instead of reusing meanings.

nodes.label: Model Kode Respons 7 Digit
nodes.rationale: HTTP_STATUS_CODE (3) + SERVICE_CODE (2) + CASE_CODE (2) agar error handling, observabilitas, dan troubleshooting konsisten.

nodes.label: Composite Response Code
nodes.rationale: All API responses use a 7-digit composite of HTTP status (3) + service code (2) + case code (2) so clients can parse HTTP class, module, and scenario from a single code field.

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: Verify x-signature with the environment-specific API secret so callers can reject forged or unauthorized webhook requests.

nodes.label: Webhook Exponential Retry
nodes.rationale: Failed webhook deliveries retry up to 5 times with exponential backoff; handlers must reply 200 OK within 5 seconds.

nodes.label: Constant-Time Signature Compare
nodes.rationale: Verify HMAC as timestamp + '.' + body compared with timing-safe equality to prevent timing attacks.

nodes.label: Webhook Exponential Retry
nodes.rationale: Pengiriman gagal dicoba ulang hingga 5 kali dengan pola eksponensial.

nodes.label: Webhook 5-Second Response SLA
nodes.rationale: Balas 200 OK dalam kurang dari 5 detik atau webhook akan diulang.

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: Hitung HMAC-SHA256 dari timestamp + '.' + body dengan webhook secret, bandingkan waktu-konstan dengan X-IPN-SIGNATURE.

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: Always verify webhook signatures with the environment-specific API secret so forged or replayed IPN requests are rejected.

nodes.label: Webhook Retry Logic
nodes.rationale: Failed deliveries are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff to tolerate transient merchant endpoint failures.

nodes.label: Server-Side Credential Storage
nodes.rationale: Never share API credentials or Client Secret in client-side code; keep secrets on the server.

nodes.label: Server-Side Credential Storage
nodes.rationale: Jangan pernah membagikan kredensial API atau Client Secret di kode sisi klien; simpan di server.

nodes.label: Add New IP Address Form
nodes.rationale: Admin screenshot of a create form that adds an IP address to a brand-scoped whitelist (Demo Brand Baru), with required fields marked by asterisks and mixed English/Indonesian labels.

nodes.label: Brand-Scoped IP Whitelist
nodes.rationale: The form subtitle scopes the new whitelist entry to a specific brand (Demo Brand Baru) rather than a global allowlist.

nodes.label: Stacked Labeled Form Layout
nodes.rationale: Vertical stack of full-width fields with labels above inputs, helper text below, secondary Back to List on the left, and primary Add IP Address (save) on the right.

nodes.label: Powered by React Illustration
nodes.rationale: Default Docusaurus homepage graphic that advertises React as the UI framework behind the docs site, pairing a developer workstation with the Keytar mascot and the official React atom.

nodes.label: Transaction Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Payin: pending to completed, expired, or failed. Payout: pending to completed or failed then refund. Stop polling on final states; poll every 15-30 seconds.

nodes.label: Withdrawal Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Usually pending, then awaiting_* processing states, ending in completed or failed; failed amounts are typically reconciled back and may show as refunded.

nodes.label: Cactus Arm Blossoms
nodes.rationale: Lighter-green (#44D860) circular flower-like puffs crowning each cactus arm, giving the mascot a playful bloomed silhouette.

nodes.label: Green Cactus Mascot
nodes.rationale: Primary character: rounded green cactus body (#3ECC5F) with a serrated spiky left edge, two arms, black oval eyes, and a wavy black smile.

nodes.label: Docusaurus Site Logo
nodes.rationale: Site brand mark: a cartoon cactus with a yellow lined notepad, the official Docusaurus mascot used as this documentation site's logo.

nodes.label: Yellow Lined Notepad
nodes.rationale: Yellow (#FFFF50) rounded page with horizontal black rules attached to the cactus, a visual metaphor for written documentation.

nodes.label: MawarPay Favicon
nodes.rationale: Square PNG site favicon: a red rose fused with a navy geometric wallet/card base on a transparent background, used as the compact MawarPay brand mark in browser tabs.

nodes.label: Gold Card-Chip Accent
nodes.rationale: Small rounded gold rectangle on the upper-right of the navy form, resembling an EMV chip or card slot and tying the mark to payments.

nodes.label: Gold-Outlined Red Rose
nodes.rationale: Top-down blooming rose with saturated red petals and thin gold outlines; mawar means rose, so the blossom is the brand name as an icon.

nodes.label: Navy Wallet Base
nodes.rationale: Dark navy angular form under the rose with a left-side cutout; reads as a stylized wallet or payment card that the rose emerges from.

nodes.label: Sandbox Environment
nodes.rationale: Credentials and data are isolated between sandbox and production environments.

nodes.label: Sandbox Testing
nodes.rationale: Sandbox mirrors production but all transactions are simulated with no real money processing.

nodes.label: Environment Isolation
nodes.rationale: Never mix sandbox credentials with production URLs; keep API keys and tokens isolated; validate webhooks and signatures separately per environment; smoke-test in sandbox before production.

nodes.label: feeType QRIS
nodes.rationale: SELLER membebankan biaya ke merchant; CUSTOMER membebankan biaya ke pelanggan.

nodes.label: feeType VA
nodes.rationale: SELLER membebankan biaya ke merchant; CUSTOMER membebankan biaya ke pelanggan.

nodes.label: Markdown Page Example
nodes.rationale: Standalone pages can be written in Markdown without React.

nodes.label: IP Address Field
nodes.rationale: Required field; helper text asks for a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address (example 192.168.1.1).

nodes.label: IP Range CIDR Field
nodes.rationale: Optional CIDR range (example 192.168.1.0/24) in addition to a single IP address.

nodes.label: Active Toggle
nodes.rationale: Aktif switch defaults on so a new entry can be enabled or disabled without deleting it.

nodes.label: Description Field
nodes.rationale: Optional Deskripsi textarea for a human-readable note on the whitelist entry.

nodes.label: Expires At Datetime Picker
nodes.rationale: Optional expiration; helper text says leave empty for permanent access.

nodes.label: Type Dropdown
nodes.rationale: Required Indonesian-labeled Tipe select with placeholder Select Type; concrete type options are not visible.

nodes.label: bank_code
nodes.rationale: bank_id from the banks list and wallet_id from the wallets list are passed as bank_code when creating withdrawal accounts.

nodes.label: Production Bank Account Verification
nodes.rationale: Di produksi, akun bank diverifikasi dengan payment gateway sebelum dibuat.

nodes.label: Permanent Withdraw Account Delete
nodes.rationale: Penghapusan akun penarikan permanen dan tidak dapat dibatalkan.

nodes.label: API Resource data Envelope
nodes.rationale: Semua endpoint membungkus sumber daya dalam kunci data; error memakai success, message, dan errors.

nodes.label: Smallest Currency Unit Amounts
nodes.rationale: Wallet APIs always return amounts in the smallest currency unit; convert before display.

nodes.label: Positive Balance Filter
nodes.rationale: List wallets returns only wallets with positive balance; empty wallets are filtered out.

nodes.label: Withdrawal Validation Rules
nodes.rationale: Withdrawals require an active daily schedule, matching wallet/account currency, min/max method limits, sufficient balance, and an account owned by the authenticated user.

nodes.label: Smallest Currency Unit
nodes.rationale: Wallet APIs return amounts in the smallest currency unit so clients must convert to major units before display.

nodes.label: Withdrawal Validations
nodes.rationale: Withdrawals require same-day schedule enablement, matching wallet/account currency, min/max method limits, sufficient balance, and account ownership by the authenticated user.

nodes.label: IP Whitelist
nodes.rationale: Requests from non-whitelisted IPs are rejected even with valid credentials, so compromised API keys cannot be used from unauthorized hosts.

nodes.label: Sandbox Payment Status Management
nodes.rationale: Hanya tersedia di sandbox untuk development dan testing.

nodes.label: CIDR Ranges
nodes.rationale: Prefer CIDR ranges for dynamic IPs, load balancers, and proxies instead of constantly rewriting single addresses.

nodes.label: IP Whitelist Defense in Depth
nodes.rationale: Unlisted IPs are rejected even with valid API credentials, adding a layer if keys leak.

nodes.label: trxReference QRIS
nodes.rationale: Referensi unik merchant untuk idempotensi dan rekonsiliasi; harus unik untuk mencegah transaksi duplikat.

nodes.label: trxReference withdrawal
nodes.rationale: Referensi unik merchant untuk idempotensi agar pengajuan payout tidak duplikat.

nodes.label: trxId
nodes.rationale: System-generated transaction identifier stored after create and used with Type TRX_ID for status lookup and server-side reconciliation.

nodes.label: trxReference
nodes.rationale: Merchant transaction reference used with trxId for reconciliation and as an idempotency key on create endpoints.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Identifiers
nodes.rationale: Store both trxId and trxReference for reconciliation.

nodes.label: feeType
nodes.rationale: CUSTOMER means the payer bears the service cost; SELLER means the merchant bears it. Defaults to SELLER if omitted.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/withdraw-accounts
nodes.rationale: In production the bank account is verified with the payment gateway before the withdrawal account is created.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/v1/withdraw-accounts/{id}
nodes.rationale: Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/withdraw-accounts/{id}/info
nodes.rationale: Limits, charges, and processing times should be shown to users before they initiate withdrawals.

nodes.label: PUT /api/v1/withdraw-accounts/{id}
nodes.rationale: Updates re-verify the bank account with the payment gateway in production.

nodes.label: Production Bank Verification
nodes.rationale: In production, bank accounts are verified with the payment gateway before they are created.

nodes.label: Send Test Webhook
nodes.rationale: Secondary footer action beside Save Settings; lets the operator fire a sample delivery to the configured endpoint without waiting for a real transaction.

nodes.label: Verify SSL Toggle
nodes.rationale: HTTPS certificate verification shown on. Copy instructs disabling only for local development with self-signed certs.

nodes.label: Webhook Endpoint URL
nodes.rationale: Required HTTPS URL field with inline validity check (green check and Valid URL). Copy states transaction events are posted to this destination.

nodes.label: Webhook Secret
nodes.rationale: Masked shared secret with Reveal, Copy, and Regenerate. Payloads are signed with this value so receivers can verify authenticity server-side.

nodes.label: Webhook Settings Page
nodes.rationale: Account-settings screenshot of the Webhook Settings tab: a three-section form (endpoint, status/security, secret) with Save Settings and Send Test Webhook, used to document how operators configure webhook delivery.

nodes.label: QRIS Expiration Time
nodes.rationale: QRIS payments expire after expiration_time minutes (30–1440, default 60) so unpaid sessions cannot be completed indefinitely.

nodes.label: success Field Error Handling
nodes.rationale: Selalu periksa field success dalam respons API dan tangani error di aplikasi.

nodes.label: Sandbox Mode
nodes.rationale: Sandbox mirrors production with simulated transactions and no real funds.

nodes.label: Sandbox-Only Status Management
nodes.rationale: Dashboard Payment → Set Status is available only in sandbox for development and testing.

nodes.label: Polling Status Transaksi
nodes.rationale: Poll setiap 15-30 detik dan hentikan saat status final (paid, completed, failed, atau expired) untuk mengurangi beban request.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/banks
nodes.rationale: Fetch bankCode, bankName, and type before creating bank-related transactions to prevent invalid routing codes and keep selectors synchronized.

nodes.label: holdBalance
nodes.rationale: Use balance and holdBalance together when calculating spendable funds; merchants can have multiple currency wallets.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/withdraw-accounts
nodes.rationale: In production, bank account ownership and validity are verified by the payment gateway before creation.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/withdraw
nodes.rationale: Generate unique trxReference to prevent duplicate payouts; retry only safe transient failures, never blindly for business rejections.

nodes.label: Endpoint yang Dilindungi
nodes.rationale: Sebagian besar endpoint memerlukan Authorization Bearer token dan X-API-KEY sebelum go-live.

nodes.label: Protected Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Most endpoints require both Authorization Bearer token and X-API-KEY; confirm required headers on each page before going live.

nodes.label: Authorization Bearer
nodes.rationale: Access token obtained from login; do not expose tokens in client-side or browser applications; rotate compromised credentials immediately.

nodes.label: Withdrawal Validations
nodes.rationale: Withdrawals require same-day schedule enablement, matching wallet/account currency, method min/max limits, sufficient wallet balance, and that the account belongs to the authenticated user.

nodes.label: Retry Kondisi Transien
nodes.rationale: Tangani HTTP status dulu lalu field code; retry hanya untuk 429 dan sebagian 5xx.

nodes.label: Exponential Backoff
nodes.rationale: Retry 429 dengan exponential backoff plus jitter, hormati Retry-After, dan hanya retry operasi idempotent.

nodes.label: Retry Webhook Exponential Backoff
nodes.rationale: Pengiriman webhook yang gagal di-retry hingga 5 kali dengan exponential backoff.

nodes.label: Exponential Backoff
nodes.rationale: On 429 stop immediate retries, wait for Retry-After or backoff with jitter, and retry idempotent operations only. Prefer webhooks over aggressive polling.

nodes.label: Webhook Retry Policy
nodes.rationale: Failed webhook deliveries are retried up to 5 times using exponential backoff for reliable IPN delivery.

nodes.label: Available Balance
nodes.rationale: available_balance is total balance minus hold_balance; hold_balance is funds locked for pending transactions.

nodes.label: Wallet Ownership Check
nodes.rationale: The API validates that the requested wallet belongs to the authenticated merchant.

nodes.label: x-signature HMAC-SHA256
nodes.rationale: Always verify webhook signatures with the environment-specific API secret to ensure authenticity and prevent unauthorized requests.

nodes.label: Webhook Retry Logic
nodes.rationale: Failed webhook deliveries are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff to improve reliable delivery of payment status notifications.

nodes.label: Composite Response Code
nodes.rationale: All API responses use a 7-digit composite code HTTP_STATUS_CODE + SERVICE_CODE + CASE_CODE so callers can distinguish HTTP outcome, owning service, and specific scenario in one field.

nodes.label: Create Withdrawal Account
nodes.rationale: In production the bank account is verified with the payment gateway before the withdrawal account is created.

nodes.label: Update Withdrawal Account
nodes.rationale: In production the bank account is re-verified with the payment gateway on update.

nodes.label: API Resource Responses
nodes.rationale: All withdrawal-account endpoints wrap payloads in a data key (object for a single resource, array for a collection) for consistent transformation.

nodes.label: Wallet Ownership Validation
nodes.rationale: API memvalidasi bahwa dompet milik merchant terautentikasi.

nodes.label: Smallest Currency Unit Amounts
nodes.rationale: API dompet mengembalikan jumlah dalam satuan mata uang terkecil; konversi sebelum tampil ke pengguna.

nodes.label: Positive Balance Filter
nodes.rationale: List wallets hanya mengembalikan dompet dengan saldo positif; saldo 0 difilter.

nodes.label: Wallet-Account Currency Match
nodes.rationale: Dompet dan akun penarikan harus memakai mata uang yang sama; 422 jika tidak.

nodes.label: Withdrawal Day Schedule
nodes.rationale: Penarikan hanya jika jadwal hari tersebut aktif; selain itu 422 Withdrawals are not enabled for today.

nodes.label: POST api/v1/qris/create - 201
nodes.rationale: Stadium start node: a successful QRIS create (HTTP 201) is the entry point of the lifecycle.

nodes.label: Release stock or cancel order
nodes.rationale: Merchant expiry action: after expired, undo reservation by releasing stock or cancelling the order.

nodes.label: Handle failure
nodes.rationale: Merchant failure action: after failed, run failure handling instead of fulfilling the order.

nodes.label: Finalize order
nodes.rationale: Merchant success action: after paid/completed, stop polling and complete the order.

nodes.label: expired - past expiredAt
nodes.rationale: Timeout terminal status: the payer did not complete checkout before the QR validity window (expiredAt).

nodes.label: failed - not completed
nodes.rationale: Error terminal status: the payment attempt did not complete successfully.

nodes.label: pending - QR shown to payer
nodes.rationale: Awaiting-payment state: the issued QR is displayed to the payer and has not yet reached a terminal status.

nodes.label: QRIS Status Lifecycle Flowchart
nodes.rationale: Mermaid flowchart-v1 showing how a QRIS payment moves from create, through pending QR display, to mutually exclusive terminal statuses and merchant follow-up actions.

nodes.label: paid or completed - funds settled
nodes.rationale: Happy-path terminal status: payment succeeded as paid or completed and funds are settled.

nodes.label: POST virtual-account/create 201
nodes.rationale: Start node: successful VA create (HTTP 201) that issues the virtual account before any payer transfer.

nodes.label: Expired Past expiredAt
nodes.rationale: Timeout terminal: no qualifying transfer arrived before expiredAt.

nodes.label: Failed Not Completed
nodes.rationale: Failure terminal: collection did not complete successfully (distinct from expiry).

nodes.label: Finalize Order
nodes.rationale: Merchant follow-up after paid or completed: fulfill and close the order.

nodes.label: Handle Failure
nodes.rationale: Merchant follow-up after failed: run failure handling rather than fulfilling the order.

nodes.label: Paid or Completed Funds Received
nodes.rationale: Success terminal: funds received, expressed as either paid or completed.

nodes.label: Pending VA Details Shown to Payer
nodes.rationale: Awaiting-transfer state: VA number and details are shown to the payer until payment, expiry, or failure.
nodes.norm_label: pending va details shown to payer

nodes.label: Release Reservation or Cancel Order
nodes.rationale: Merchant follow-up after expiry: drop the held reservation or cancel the unpaid order.

nodes.label: Virtual Account Status Lifecycle Flowchart
nodes.rationale: Mermaid flowchart-v1 of the VA collection lifecycle: HTTP 201 create, pending payer transfer, then a three-way fork to paid/completed, expired, or failed, each with a merchant follow-up action.

nodes.label: Composite Response Code
nodes.rationale: All API responses use a standardized 7-digit code: HTTP status (3) + service code (2) + case code (2), so callers can distinguish module and scenario without parsing message text.

nodes.label: QRIS qrImage
nodes.rationale: Clients generate scannable QRIS codes from the returned qrImage data rather than composing the EMV payload themselves.

nodes.label: Pemisahan Environment
nodes.rationale: Jangan mencampur kredensial sandbox dengan URL production; pisahkan API key, token, dan validasi webhook per environment.

nodes.label: Set Status Hanya Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Endpoint simulasi status hanya ada di sandbox agar testing tidak menunggu settlement jaringan; tidak tersedia di production.

nodes.label: Sandbox-Only Status Simulation
nodes.rationale: Available only on the sandbox base URL so integrators can force status transitions without real bank or network settlement; not exposed on production.

nodes.label: refunded — funds returned to merchant balance
nodes.norm_label: refunded — funds returned to merchant balance

nodes.label: accessToken
nodes.rationale: JWT used as Authorization Bearer on protected endpoints; treat expiresIn as expiry metadata and refresh before expiry.

nodes.label: refreshToken
nodes.rationale: Store securely and revoke on logout or suspicious activity; used to request a new access token.

nodes.label: JWT Bearer Authentication
nodes.rationale: Token-based authentication: obtain accessToken via login, send Authorization Bearer on protected endpoints, refresh before expiration.

nodes.label: MawarPay API v1
nodes.rationale: Designed for backend-to-backend integrations with consistent JSON responses, JWT authentication, predictable response codes, and secure scalable patterns.

nodes.label: Rotasi Refresh Token
nodes.rationale: API dapat merotasi refreshToken pada setiap refresh; simpan token baru dengan aman dan login ulang jika 401 berulang.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation
nodes.rationale: API may rotate refreshToken on each successful refresh; store the new token securely. Repeated 401 from refresh requires a full login.

nodes.label: API v1 Versioning
nodes.rationale: This document set is for API v1 only; new additions should remain backward-compatible; breaking changes should be released under a new major version.
